record.title: Minimality conjecture for trace reductions of three 3x3 matrices
record.statement: Let $R$ be an evaluation map obtained from the trace reduction referred to in the source, and let the chosen monomials be the monomials used to construct the corresponding generating set of trace relations. **Minimality conjecture.** If we choose $R$ as in the trace reduction, then the chosen monomials always form a minimal generating set. This asserts that the trace-reduction procedure produces a minimal generating set for the relevant kernel of the evaluation map; the supplied text gives no evidence that the conjecture has been resolved.
record.source_name: Torsten Hoge, “A presentation of the trace algebra of three 3x3 matrices”, arXiv:1104.0904 (2011).
record.references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1104.0904

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2011).
